introduction: LawHelpNY offers free legal information and a directory of civil legal aid providers. Search by location and legal issue.
description: LawHelpNY offers free legal information and a directory of civil legal aid providers. Search by location and legal issue.

sections.who: Public resources are available to everyone. Providers separately screen income, issue and capacity.
sections.get: The site connects people with information and legal-help options; it does not guarantee a lawyer.
sections.docs:
• County and legal issue.
  • Court papers, notices and dates.
  • Income information for provider screening.
sections.apply:
1. Find resources

    Use LawHelpNY and the legal-help directory.

  2. Request intake

    Contact the listed provider, explain deadlines and ask what records it needs.

  3. Use LiveHelp if needed

    The site lists chat Monday–Thursday,9a.m.–9p.m., excluding most holidays.
sections.after: Follow court deadlines. Ask a qualified provider about the rules that apply to your case.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using LawHelpNY resources and chat. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
